labels.note: For i==="/", split yields only empty parts, always skipped by inner !s check; branch redundant.
Condition always false (i can't be both falsy and "/"); same as removing check, which is dead code.
Input pre-filtered with Boolean, so !i is always false; condition becomes always-false, harmless.
i is never "" (pre-filtered) and !i always false, so condition always false; no observable change.
Even if condition true (i==="/"), inner loop naturally pushes nothing, so continue is redundant.
Drops length===1 check; ".." fails to pop segments whenever base has protocol, breaking relative navigation e.g. resolving http://host/a/b + ../../c.
Removing sindex===1 restriction only diverges with unusual multi-arg inputs leaving a dangling "x:/" segment; rare realistic case.
endsWith("") is always true, wrongly merging ordinary path tokens and undercounting segmentsDepth, e.g. joinRelativeURL("a/b","../..") wrongly returns "../" instead of "".
